text: In the psychiatric hospital, the nurses were preparing the dining hall for an afternoon event. Arthur, a patient who loved gingerbread from the bakery, was sitting in the corner eating a snack while painters applied fresh plaster to the hallway walls. When an orderly opened the heavy door, a draft of wind blew plaster dust across the room, contaminating Arthur's gingerbread. The head nurse told Arthur to discard the spoiled food and step into the courtyard for fresh air. Arthur sulked as he walked outside, watching the maintenance workers repair the cracked wall.
